prep.summary:
Modernization and observability work is complete: request IDs now propagate through context/logs, configuration logging excludes sensitive values, and billing failures use structured logging. Relevant tests pass, including health-log field validation and payment tests (18 passed, 1 skipped because Stripe was unavailable).

The remaining scheduler issue involved recurrence calculations across the March DST transition. Previously, combining a date, naive local time, and timezone data could shift execution from the intended local time; CLI output showed 10:00 Pacific / 14:00 UTC instead of 09:00 / 13:00 UTC. `src/ledgerly/scheduler/recurrence.py` was fixed to construct the scheduled datetime in the configured timezone and convert it to UTC. All 8 scheduler tests now pass, including the recurring-invoice DST case.

A new test, `test_midnight_dst_transition_keeps_local_time`, was added in `tests/test_scheduler.py`. It schedules execution for 00:30 Pacific across the spring DST transition and checks that the result remains 00:30 Pacific after UTC conversion. Its outcome still needs to be confirmed.

Next steps: run and validate the midnight/other DST edge-case tests, rerun the complete test suite, and then address deferred enhancements: invoice-list pagination/summary optimization, first-class partial refunds, injected billing-session validation, improved idempotency documentation, and optional PDF or resource-usage review.

8. Run cutover smoke test: `curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/cache/health | jq -e '.redis.primary == "redis-new.internal:6379" and .status == "ok"'`
9. Disable old write path: `systemctl disable --now cache-dualwrite.service` (turn 133)
